'''Oa Park''' was a park on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It had within its boundaries more than thirty different environments which simulated various other worlds. Each environment had its own [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] mix, [[Star/Legends|solar]] spectrum, and [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] field, separated from each other by energy boundaries.<ref name="MedStar I" />
